evidence.text: Implementation consultant at an HR software company for three years, configuring the payroll and absence products for twenty‑three mid‑sized employers under the configuration standard.

Ran the policy workshops for each implementation under the workshop method; the workshop records show the policy decisions captured, including the disagreements within customer teams resolved into a recorded decision, with the customers' sign‑off on each workshop record.
Loaded and reconciled each customer's employee data with the data migration team, with the reconciliation report signed by the customer's HR lead.
evidence.notes: Data loading and reconciliation with sign‑off.

evidence.text: Trained the customers' HR administrators under the training plan; go‑live approval was the implementation manager's, recorded on the go‑live checklist together with which checks were mine.
Wrote the limitation note and the hand‑over conditions for each implementation in the hand‑over pack to the support team.
